rounds.response:
- Finish the entire antibiotic course exactly as prescribed; take each dose at the same time each day and with food if it upsets your stomach.  
- Stay active with short, gentle walks and gradually increase activity as you feel better; avoid heavy exertion until your breathing is back to normal.  
- Seek urgent medical care if you develop a new fever, more trouble breathing, chest pain, fainting/lightheadedness, confusion, or if you cannot eat or take your medicines.  
- Arrange a follow-up visit in about one week and plan a repeat chest x‑ray in 6–8 weeks to confirm the pneumonia has resolved.
